body.message:
Dear FAM Living Team/ Tharushi 

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to formally record the current status of my short-term tenancy at City Walk Building 6A, Apartment 202 (2-bedroom + maid's room) and to request your written confirmation to avoid any further misunderstanding.

Earlier today, I was informed by Mr. Junaid Ahmad that my tenancy had expired and that today was my scheduled check-out date. This was unexpected, as Mr. Junaid had previously confirmed to me via WhatsApp on 11 June 2026 that my tenancy had been extended for one additional month until 24 August 2026 at the existing monthly rental of AED 12,333.

I immediately referred Mr. Junaid to his written confirmation dated 11 June 2026. Following this, he acknowledged the previous confirmation and agreed via WhatsApp that the extension remains in place.

Notwithstanding this, I believe it is important that FAM Living's records accurately reflect the current position. At present, my guest portal indicates that my stay has ended, despite the agreed extension. This is understandably concerning and could potentially create unnecessary issues during my continued occupation of the apartment.

I will be sharing proof of payment of the monthly rent in the amount of AED 12,333, covering the rental period from 24 July 2026 to 24 August 2026, shortly.

Accordingly, I would appreciate your written confirmation of the following:

1. That my tenancy for City Walk Building 6A, Apartment 202 has been formally extended until 24 August 2026.

2. That the agreed rent for the extension period is AED 12,333, and that my payment for the period 24 July 2026 to 24 August 2026 will be reflected against my account upon receipt of the payment confirmation.

3. That my tenancy records, including the guest portal and any internal systems maintained by FAM Living, will be updated to reflect my current tenancy and revised check-out date of 24 August 2026.

4. That all other terms and conditions of my tenancy remain unchanged unless otherwise agreed in writing.

Finally, as I am considering extending my stay beyond 24 August 2026, I would be grateful if you could provide your best monthly rental rate for the period commencing 24 August 2026 (or September 2026 onwards). I will consider the revised rental and advise whether I wish to proceed with a further extension.

I would appreciate receiving your written confirmation at your earliest convenience so that both parties have a clear and consistent record of the current tenancy arrangements.

Thank you, and I look forward to your prompt response.

Kind regards,

Ayesha Najeeb
